programme.title: Upfront in the Prophetic with Francine FosdickUpfront in the Prophetic with Francine Fosdick - From Diagnosis to Purpose A Pharmacist s Journey of Faith Wellness and Hope
programme.desc: Tonight on Upfront in the Prophetic we welcome Dr Kareem Griffith — a pharmacist man of faith and wellness advocate whose life took an unexpected turn after being diagnosed with congestive heart failure In one of the most difficult seasons of his life a dear friend reached out because they genuinely cared about what he was going through That conversation opened the door to a journey that would not only impact his health but also his purpose and outlook on wellness Tonight Dr Griffith shares Why he said “yes” to this company Why a successful pharmacist would even consider becoming involved What the products have personally meant to him The importance of cellular communication and the new acemannan technology The Kingdom-minded mission behind the company The incredible work being done through MannaRelief feeding children in over 90 countries Why this opportunity is for everyday people — not just doctors or medical professionals And how faith played a major role in his decision to become part of this movement This is more than a conversation about products It’s a conversation about purpose compassion restoration and making a difference in people’s lives

programme.title: The Mondo Show - John Cooper
programme.desc: Go behind the scenes with John Cooper lead vocalist bassist songwriter and producer for Skillet one of the best-selling rock bands of the 21st century In this powerful conversation John shares why he chose to risk his reputation and career rather than stay silent in a culture increasingly hostile to biblical truth As cancel culture confusion and the deconstruction of faith continue to sweep across society John delivers a bold and timely message Jesus Christ is still the answer Together we discuss the challenges facing believers today the pressure to compromise and why standing firm on Gods Word matters now more than ever This is more than an interview; its a call to courage conviction and unwavering faith in a world searching for truth

programme.title: SkywatchTV - Michael Heisers Legacy Continues
